finder.title: Friends nearby
finder.subtitle: Find your crew with no signal
finder.how_body: Create a group for tonight and invite your friends. With the Bluetooth radar on, your phones detect each other even without coverage, and you see who's close.
finder.empty: You don't have any groups yet
finder.nfc_waiting: Hold the back of your phone against your friend's phone, which must have the group open on screen.
finder.invalid_code: Invalid or expired code, or the group is full
finder.invite_body: They can scan this QR, enter the code or tap their phone against yours (NFC) from “Join a group”.
finder.nfc_no_invite: Detected, but there's no invite. If it's your friend's phone, they need the group open on screen, with the screen on and unlocked.
finder.nfc_lost: The NFC connection dropped. Keep the phones together for a couple of seconds.
finder.nfc_not_invite: This is not a group invite.
finder.share_text: Join my group “{{name}}” on Blow Nights (Friends nearby) with the code {{code}}
finder.radar_off: Turn it on to detect your crew without coverage. It keeps working with the screen off.
finder.radar_on: Looking for your crew. Your phone also broadcasts so they can find you.
finder.no_permission: Blow Nights needs the nearby devices permission to use the radar
finder.no_ble: This phone doesn't support the Bluetooth radar
finder.no_advertise: Your phone can detect your friends but can't broadcast: they won't see you
finder.android_only: For now the Bluetooth radar is only available on Android
finder.notif_text: Looking for your crew over Bluetooth
finder.meeting_empty: No meeting point. Set one in case you get separated.
finder.meeting_label_hint: E.g. Bar 3, next to the sound tower
finder.meeting_pick_map: Mark the spot on the map (optional)
finder.not_found: This group no longer exists or has expired
finder.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

door_camera_denied_app: We can't use the camera. Validate with the pass PIN or allow the camera in the app settings.

nfc_pass.hint: You can also tap your phone on the staff's phone (NFC).
nfc_pass.empty_ticket: That phone isn't showing a ticket. Ask them to open it and tap again.
nfc_pass.empty_drink: That phone isn't showing a drink. Ask them to open it and tap again.

staff_app.scan_or_tap: Scan the venue's QR or tap your phone on the manager's phone (NFC).
